name: Stealth Yarou
source:
Toru Suki has become invisible by chance.However, taking advantage of his invisibility, he persistently plays sexual pranks on Momoka Nagakura.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ131938.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
须木彻偶然变得透明。于是，他利用隐身能力，纠缠不休地对长仓桃香进行性骚扰恶作剧。
